newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat up on export demand.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat up on export demand.

text.p: Argentine wheat was firmer in good volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange midsession Thursday, with prices buoyed by good export demand.

Prices paid to farmers for April wheat firmed $3 to $141. A bullish factor was rumored sales to the Middle East and Asia. April maize was unchanged in low volume. May soybeans were steady in moderate turnover, with good demand from crushers and bean exporters also in the market. April sunflower seed fought back in tight trade after several weak showings, gaining $3 to $200. But oil sales remain scant.
